description: This line plot, titled “ChatGPT on Movies,” illustrates the relationship between question popularity and three metrics—Accuracy, Confidence, and Alignment—for a model interacting with movie-related questions. The x-axis, labeled “Question Popularity,” spans from 15 to 55 on a linear scale, with tick marks at regular intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled “Values,” ranges from 0.86 to 1.00, also on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 0.02. The blue line with circle markers represents Accuracy, starting at approximately 0.895 at Question Popularity 15, dipping to 0.90 at 16, rising to 0.96 at 20, then generally increasing to 0.985 at 55. The green line with triangle markers represents Confidence, beginning near 0.98 at 15, fluctuating slightly, and rising to 0.995 at 55. The red line with square markers represents Alignment, starting at 0.92 at 15, showing a sharp increase to 0.975 at 20, then gradually rising to 0.99 at 55. All three metrics remain above 0.92 across the entire range of question popularity.
